title: Source call: leaked HengLi Power LX-7 cell test report

lines.text: Thanks for getting on, 赵工. For the record, this call is off the record and nothing goes out without your sign-off. Dave, Rachel and Jing are on with me.
好。说白了，我只想让这份报告被看见。LX-7电芯在45度循环测试里热失控率是0.8%，对外披露的是0.02%，差了40倍。
That's a headline number. Bottom line, I need to know who inside approved the 0.02% figure and whether the board saw the 0.8%.
质量副总刘振华6月签的字。我们BMS验证组2月就把数据报上去了，被要求'重新定义失效标准'，把冒烟不起火的不算。
To be clear, as outside counsel for Meridian I have to ask: how did you obtain the PDF? Did you breach a confidentiality agreement or access systems you weren't authorized for?
报告是我自己写的初稿，我有权限。我2021年4月6日入职就签了保密协议，这个我清楚。说白了，风险我认。
Let me flag one thing: the PDF metadata shows author 'zlei' and a creation date of March 3. If HengLi checks document logs, that points straight at you.
Jing's right. We won't publish the document itself, only describe it. For the record, I covered the Takata airbag recall for four years and protecting sources is the whole job.
那就好。之后别打我工作号，用私人号139-1762-4408，或者邮件zl_backup2026@proton.me。
Bottom line, one document isn't enough. We need a second independent source or HengLi's own response before we run anything.
I used to work at CATL's Ningde lab, so I can sanity-check the test protocol. A 45°C cycle at 1C for 800 cycles is standard; 0.8% is plausible for a bad separator batch.
就是隔膜的问题，供应商换了一家便宜的，每平米省0.6块。苏州工业园区星湖街218号那个二号厂房的线全在用。
To be clear, we should not print the plant address or the supplier name until we have documentary confirmation. Defamation exposure in Hong Kong and PRC courts is real.
Rachel, I disagree on the supplier. If the separator swap is the cause, naming it is the public-interest core. About 120,000 vehicles carry LX-7 packs.
Mei, I'm with Rachel for draft one. We can add the supplier in a follow-up once we have the purchase orders.
采购单我拿不到。不过我在github.com/zhaolei-bms放过一个公开的SOC估算工具，你们别去看，那个账号跟我真名挂钩。
Let me flag that too, then. Zhao, please delete or privatize that repo now; the commit emails will deanonymize you within a day.
明白。说实话我压力很大，我老婆刚生二胎，要是被开除房贷都还不上。
Then let's talk whistleblower routes. You could file with SAMR's defect recall center in parallel. My direct line is +1 415-555-0187 if you want advice outside this group.
I'll send HengLi a request for comment on Monday with a 72-hour deadline. Questions come from mlin@meridianwire.com; I'll also watch weibo.com/u/linmei_ev for any owner complaints.
I'll pull the 2025 and 2026 owner fire reports from SAMR and the forums. If anyone tips via DM, my handle is @sunjing_checks. Let me flag: so far I count 9 thermal incidents with LX-7 packs.
Nine incidents plus the internal number gets us there. Bottom line: target publication October 2, contingent on legal sign-off and HengLi's response.
Agreed, with conditions: no quotes attributed to 'an engineer in the BMS team', just 'a person with direct knowledge'. That team has fewer than 15 people.
谢谢黄律师。说白了，只要车不再烧，我被查出来也认了。
Thanks, Leo. For the record, we'll talk again Sunday at 9pm on Signal only. Delete this call log.
Good work, everyone. Jing, send me the incident spreadsheet by Friday.

ideas.text: Internal tests show LX-7 cells had a 0.8% thermal runaway rate at 45°C cycling versus a disclosed 0.02%, about 40 times higher.
The failure definition was redefined to exclude smoke-without-fire cases after the data was reported upward.
Publication requires a second independent source or the company's response; one document is not enough.
Plant address and supplier name should not be printed without documentary confirmation due to defamation risk.
Naming the cheaper separator supplier is the public-interest core since about 120,000 vehicles carry LX-7 packs.
The PDF metadata and a linked public code repository could deanonymize the source and must be scrubbed.
Public records show 9 thermal incidents involving LX-7 packs, corroborating the internal data.
Target publication is October 2, contingent on legal sign-off and the company's response to a 72-hour comment request.
The source should be described only as a person with direct knowledge, and could file in parallel with the regulator's recall center.
